limitations: 3 actual callback harness tests execute current App identity and callback bodies with controlled refs, storage and rAF; they do not mount React App or prove browser effect timing.

Actual same-viewport reload, cross-viewport restore, explicit-fit precedence, native pan preview/cancel/commit, save/reopen and export/source/history invariants require parent-owned browser/build evidence.

There is no ResizeObserver or live viewport resizing policy. Reload/initialization uses the current viewport and world centre; viewport readiness is retried for at most 4 frames, then requires an explicit view operation.
Session storage is the reload scope; close/new-tab persistence is not claimed. Exact visualRevision rejection deliberately avoids restoring a view captured from a different unsaved visual state.
A visual document change before initialization invalidates the conservative document-object/revision ticket; initialization does not replace that newer document.
No claim is made for human participants, publication-size review, presented FPS, or M4 completion.
